notes.title: Kili's Treasure is going free!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and happy new year!

After a lot of thought and deliberation I have decided to make all of my games including Kili's Treasure completely free.

It has been a tough couple of years for all of us, and for me specifically it meant giving up on professional indie-game development. 

However, I love this game and want as many people to enjoy it as possible. With that in mind I think it's best to make this game available for free. I have asked the folks at Valve to make this change on the 15th of February 2022.

Those of you have bought the game, I can't thank you enough for your support! 

Hope you have a great 2022!

Thank you.
Siddharth

notes.title: Timpu's Treasure - A new game in the treasure hunt stories franchise!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to announce that a new game in the treasure hunt franchise called Timpu's treasure is now out! The game mechanic is similar to Kili's treasure but with more clues, more characters, side-quests and a whole new story!

If you enjoyed playing Kili's Treasure, we think you might like Timpu's treasure as well! We hope you give it a go and can't wait to hear what you think.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186690/Timpus_treasure/

notes.title: Kili's treasure is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm really happy to announce that Kili's treasure is out now! I can't wait for you to try it out and hear your thoughts! 

In case you have any problems in the game (or if you're stuck anywhere), feel free to post on the forums for help.

Happy playing!

- Sid
